purpose: Lock each AI scenario's spatial, data, human-accountability, stop, and recovery contract to G1/G2 professional review responsibilities.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored desktop-review matrix only. It names role types, methods, and missing evidence, not real institutions, statutory approval, engineering capacity, field performance, procurement, or implementation permission.

gate_boundary.G1: desktop professional review may begin from this template; all surveyed values and professional findings remain missing
gate_boundary.G2: controlled tabletop/drill review may be planned; no live data, live model, device, participant, or public operation is authorised
gate_boundary.G3: closed until rights, surveys, professional sign-offs, baseline, responsible institutions, budget, and authorisation exist

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: AI原点成果街与开放首层
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: AI Origin results street and open ground floor
minimum_data: voluntarily submitted project package
asset-level source, licence, consent, and attribution record
scenarios.human_final_accountability: curatorial operator role type makes the final publish, correct, or withdraw decision

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: survey clear public route, egress, display fixing, service position, and no-account access
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no capacity or opening claim until surveyed and reviewed

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: licence, consent, attribution, or conflict-of-interest evidence cannot be verified
scenarios.pause_line: withhold or remove the affected release immediately

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 众智园隔离测试庭与可观察廊
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: Zhongzhiyuan isolated test court and observer gallery
minimum_data: synthetic or authorised test cases
purpose, model/version, scope, event, and incident log
scenarios.human_final_accountability: test-site operator role type controls admission, emergency stop, and closure

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: survey isolation envelope, observer separation, bypass continuity, cutoff reach, and evacuation condition
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no live model, device, or crowd capacity claim before G1/G2 evidence

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: out-of-scope collection, loss of isolation, severe incident, or ineffective emergency stop
scenarios.pause_line: isolate the system and close the test court
resume_evidence: new stop drill plus independent safety sign-off

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 众智园受控设备台与分离观察路径
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: Zhongzhiyuan controlled device bench and separated observer route
minimum_data: de-identified event log
device, firmware, model, interface, and test-scope versions
scenarios.human_final_accountability: test-site operator role type approves connection, disconnection, and incident closure

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: measure equipment envelope, electrical load, network segmentation, maintenance clearance, and public separation
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: power, network, and device count remain unknown until professional verification

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: unauthorised collection, interface escape, unsafe load, or failed disconnection
scenarios.pause_line: disconnect affected devices and freeze their logs

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 众智园解释廊与可检修服务柜
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: Zhongzhiyuan explanation corridor and maintainable service cabinet
minimum_data: facility-level aggregated energy, temperature, uptime, source, and timestamp
no personal inference or device payload
scenarios.human_final_accountability: facilities/operator role type makes the final operating and public-interpretation decision

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify electrical/cooling capacity, cabinet clearance, heat/noise boundary, maintenance access, and data freshness
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no compute, energy-saving, or expansion claim while utility capacity is unknown

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: stale or unverifiable display, unsafe heat/load, blocked maintenance, or unverified capacity
scenarios.pause_line: switch off the installation and label the display unavailable

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 公共版本脊与三条东西针脚
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: public version spine and three east-west stitches
minimum_data: aggregated route condition
voluntary obstruction report without continuous personal trajectory
scenarios.human_final_accountability: public-space operator role type makes the final closure, diversion, and public-notice decision

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: survey clear width, gradient, surface, crossing time, conflict point, closure state, and non-digital continuity
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no safe-route or travel-time claim before a current route audit

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: guidance sends a user into a hazard or the non-digital route is absent
scenarios.pause_line: withdraw the affected route and activate human/static diversion

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: AI原点至大钟寺连续公共路线
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: continuous public route from AI Origin to Dazhongsi
minimum_data: consented route task
de-identified barrier, completion/failure, repair, and withdrawal record
scenarios.human_final_accountability: public-space operator role type owns correction and closure; an independent accessibility reviewer verifies release

required_evidence: 12 consented route-task plan covering at least three need types

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: measure continuous width, slope, surface, rest/turning space, tactile/visual/audible alternative, and human assistance coverage
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: targets are not field accessibility evidence until consented users and independent review complete

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: basic continuity, alternative information, consent, or safe withdrawal fails
scenarios.pause_line: close the affected test segment without removing the basic public route

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: AI原点成果街人工服务台
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: human service desk on the AI Origin results street
minimum_data: voluntarily submitted project and rights materials
declared interests, referral purpose, and decision receipt
scenarios.human_final_accountability: qualified professional service-owner role type makes the final referral and advice decision

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify accessible queue and desk, confidential conversation boundary, human coverage, and no-account route
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no service capacity, conversion, financing, or legal outcome claim before authorised operation

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: undisclosed interest, unverifiable rights, or AI output substitutes for legal/financial judgment
scenarios.pause_line: stop the affected referral and preserve an appeal record
resume_evidence: qualified human re-review and correction receipt

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 科技服务翼人工共驾室
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: human-copilot room in the technology-service wing
minimum_data: enterprise-submitted problem and documents
purpose, field list, access, retention, withdrawal, and advice version
scenarios.human_final_accountability: qualified professional role type owns the final advice and any consequential decision

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify acoustic/visual privacy, authorised terminals, queue separation, human coverage, and deletion turnaround
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no confidentiality, response-time, or business-benefit claim before an authorised baseline

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: confidential disclosure, invalid consent, failed deletion, or unreviewed legal/financial reliance
scenarios.pause_line: isolate the case, stop advice, and open privacy/professional incident review
resume_evidence: qualified human correction plus privacy sign-off

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 大钟寺公共验收街知情与申诉段
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: notice and appeal segments of Dazhongsi acceptance street
minimum_data: purpose, fields, controller role, version, access, expiry, withdrawal, correction, and deletion receipt
scenarios.human_final_accountability: data-controller role type owns consent validity, withdrawal, correction, deletion, and incident closure

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify notice visibility, assisted-service privacy, offline route, human coverage, and withdrawal/deletion turnaround
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no live personal data or service-capacity claim before G1/G2 approval

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: purpose or controller unclear, consent invalid, or withdrawal/correction/deletion cannot execute
scenarios.pause_line: stop the affected collection and preserve the incident trail

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 大钟寺人机双轨公共客厅
minimum_data: current-session text and chosen language
default no account, face, voiceprint, or cross-session retention
scenarios.human_final_accountability: public-service operator role type owns final high-impact wording, interpretation, and escalation

required_evidence: crowd, queue, and accessible route plan

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify accessible queue, acoustic/visual separation, human coverage, language alternatives, and complaint route
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no accuracy, throughput, or inclusion claim until consented user and language review exists

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: harmful ambiguity, unavailable human review, privacy spill, or inaccessible alternative
scenarios.pause_line: withdraw the affected output and switch to human or static multilingual service

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 京张遗址公园与公共版本脊
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: Jingzhang heritage park and public version spine
minimum_data: publicly accessible historical source and rights record
statement-level verified, pending, or creative label
scenarios.human_final_accountability: heritage-editor role type makes the final factual, interpretive, correction, and withdrawal decision

required_evidence: surveyed route and reversible installation method

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify route continuity, heritage buffer, reversible fixing, legibility, dwell conflict, and non-digital alternative
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no heritage, route, or historical-fact approval implied by the concept package

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: fabricated person/event, missing source/permission, or installation conflicts with heritage/public passage
scenarios.pause_line: remove the affected statement or installation from public display

scenarios.spatial_prototype_zh: 众智园、AI原点、大钟寺三地联动
scenarios.spatial_prototype_en: linked venues at Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin, and Dazhongsi
minimum_data: publisher-cleared programme and contribution records
speaker/asset permission, attribution, conflict, correction, and cancellation status
scenarios.human_final_accountability: event-curatorial operator role type owns programme release, safety coordination, correction, and cancellation

measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.method: verify authorised occupancy, egress, accessible capacity, queue/service coverage, inter-venue transfer, and shutdown time
measurable_spatial_or_capacity_proxy.decision_boundary: no event date, attendance, partnership, sponsorship, or government schedule is claimed

scenarios.conflict_or_failure_case: uncleared content, unsafe capacity, failed accessible route, conflict, or event represented as official commitment
scenarios.pause_line: withhold the affected item or cancel the unsafe/unapproved venue segment
